fields.label: Server
fields.description: Its name in Frappe Cloud, for example u25-nuremberg-3.frappe.cloud.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Read from Frappe Cloud when Settings is saved.

fields.label: EU
fields.description: Takes the workspaces that asked for their data to stay in the EU. Tick it only for a server in the EU.

fields.label: Open
fields.description: Takes new workspaces. Untick it to stop a server filling any further.

fields.label: Most Workspaces
fields.description: How many workspaces it holds before it is full. Leave it at 0 for no limit.
